places.name: Arenal Volcano National Park
places.ai_summary: Arenal Volcano National Park is a stunning natural reserve featuring the iconic Arenal Volcano, lush rainforests, and diverse wildlife. Visitors can enjoy hiking trails, hot springs, and breathtaking views of the volcanic landscape.
places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes for hiking and bring a raincoat during the wet season.
places.address: Alajuela Province, San Carlos, Costa Rica

places.name: La Fortuna Waterfall
places.ai_summary: La Fortuna Waterfall is a majestic cascade surrounded by lush rainforest. Visitors can hike down to the base of the waterfall for a refreshing swim in the natural pool.
places.place_tip: Bring water shoes for better grip on slippery rocks.
places.address: Calle La Fortuna, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Tabacón Hot Springs
places.ai_summary: Tabacón Hot Springs is a luxurious retreat featuring natural thermal pools, lush gardens, and spa services. The hot springs are heated by the geothermal activity of Arenal Volcano.
places.place_tip: Book a day pass to enjoy the hot springs and spa facilities.
places.address: Tabacón Thermal Resort, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Mistico Hanging Bridges Park
places.ai_summary: Mistico Hanging Bridges Park offers a unique opportunity to walk across suspension bridges high above the forest floor, providing stunning views of the rainforest and Arenal Volcano.
places.place_tip: Take your time to enjoy the views and look for wildlife.
places.address: Ruta 142, La Fortuna, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Lake Arenal Boat Tour
places.ai_summary: The Lake Arenal Boat Tour is a scenic boat ride on Costa Rica's largest lake, offering views of the Arenal Volcano, lush landscapes, and opportunities to see wildlife such as monkeys and birds.
places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for wildlife watching and a camera for photos.
places.address: Arenal Lake, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Ecotermales Hot Springs
places.ai_summary: Ecotermales Hot Springs is a serene and eco-friendly hot spring facility located in the rainforest. It offers a more intimate and natural hot springs experience compared to other commercialized sites.
places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal at the on-site restaurant for a complete experience.
places.address: Ecotermales, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Arenal Observatory Lodge Trails
places.ai_summary: The Arenal Observatory Lodge Trails offer a unique opportunity to explore the rainforest and volcanic landscapes with the guidance of expert naturalists. The trails vary in difficulty and length, suitable for all levels of hikers.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and bring water and snacks.
places.address: Arenal Observatory Lodge, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Bogarin Trail (Sloth Sanctuary)
places.ai_summary: The Bogarin Trail is a private reserve offering a guided tour to see sloths in their natural habitat. The trail is well-maintained and provides excellent opportunities for wildlife photography.
places.place_tip: Be quiet and patient to increase chances of seeing sloths.
places.address: Bogarin Trail, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Arenal 1968 Lava Trail
places.ai_summary: The Arenal 1968 Lava Trail is a hiking trail that takes you through the lava fields of the 1968 eruption, offering a unique landscape and the chance to see volcanic rock formations and pioneer vegetation.
places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks, and wear sturdy shoes.
places.address: Arenal 1968, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: El Salto Rope Swing
places.ai_summary: El Salto Rope Swing is a popular spot for adventure seekers, where you can swing from a rope into the refreshing waters of the La Fortuna River. It's a fun and exhilarating experience in a beautiful natural setting.

opening_hours.notes: Best to visit during the dry season.

places.place_tip: Bring a change of clothes and water shoes.
places.address: El Salto, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Arenal Natura Ecological Park
places.ai_summary: Arenal Natura Ecological Park is a private reserve that offers a close-up experience with Costa Rican wildlife, including sloths, toucans, and butterflies. The park features walking trails, a butterfly garden, and a reptile exhibit.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for the best wildlife viewing opportunities.
places.address: Arenal Natura, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Proyecto Asis Wildlife Rescue Center
places.ai_summary: Proyecto Asis is a wildlife rescue center and rehabilitation facility that offers guided tours to learn about Costa Rican wildlife and conservation efforts. Visitors can see sloths, monkeys, birds, and other animals up close.
places.place_tip: Support the rescue center by purchasing souvenirs or making a donation.
places.address: Proyecto Asis, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Cerro Chato Trail (Closed Summit View)
places.ai_summary: The Cerro Chato Trail is a challenging hike that leads to the crater of an extinct volcano. The summit offers a stunning view of the green lagoon inside the crater, surrounded by lush forest.
places.place_tip: Bring plenty of water and snacks, and wear sturdy hiking shoes.
places.address: Cerro Chato, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Horseback Ride to Waterfall
places.ai_summary: This tour offers a unique way to explore the rainforest and see the La Fortuna Waterfall. Experienced guides lead you on horseback through scenic trails.
places.place_tip: Wear long pants and closed shoes for comfort.
places.address: La Fortuna, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Sky Adventures Zipline & Tram
places.ai_summary: Sky Adventures offers an adrenaline-pumping zipline experience with stunning views of the Arenal Volcano and Lake Arenal. The tour includes a tram ride through the rainforest.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothes and closed shoes.
places.address: Sky Adventures, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Pure Trek Canyon Rappelling
places.ai_summary: Pure Trek offers an exciting canyoning experience, including rappelling down waterfalls and hiking through lush rainforests. It's an adrenaline-filled adventure for nature lovers.
places.place_tip: Bring a change of clothes and closed-toe shoes.
places.address: Pure Trek, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Rainforest Chocolate Tour
places.ai_summary: The Rainforest Chocolate Tour offers a delicious and educational experience about the chocolate-making process, from bean to bar. Visitors can taste fresh cacao and learn about its history and cultivation.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the chance to taste the fresh cacao fruit.
places.address: Rainforest Chocolate Tour, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Venado Caves
places.ai_summary: The Venado Caves are a fascinating natural attraction featuring a series of underground caves and rivers. Guided tours allow visitors to explore the stunning rock formations and learn about the geology of the area.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothes and shoes, and bring a flashlight.
places.address: Venado Caves, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Night Frog Watching Tour
places.ai_summary: The Night Frog Watching Tour is a unique experience that takes you into the rainforest at night to observe and learn about the fascinating frogs and other nocturnal creatures that inhabit the area.
places.place_tip: Wear dark, non-reflective clothing and be quiet to avoid scaring the frogs.
places.address: La Fortuna, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica

places.name: La Fortuna Town Square
places.ai_summary: La Fortuna Town Square is the heart of the town, featuring a beautiful park, church, and local shops. It's a great place to relax, people-watch, and experience the local culture.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food and visit the shops around the square.
places.address: La Fortuna, Alajuela Province, Costa Rica
